housing.summary: Numbeo reports £897.14 per month for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Nottingham). England caps a sub-£50,000 annual-rent tenancy deposit at five weeks, but this is a legal maximum and does not establish a market norm (https://www.gov.uk/private-renting/deposits). No sourced deposit norm in months was found. Rightmove carries Nottingham rental listings (https://www.rightmove.co.uk/property-to-rent/Nottingham.html).

banking.summary: HSBC UK's official guidance says applicants need proof of identity and address; it lists passports, driving licences or EU identity cards for identity and utility or telephone bills, council-tax bills, mortgage statements or tenancy agreements for address. It says some non-UK nationals may also need a visa or residence permit (https://www.hsbc.co.uk/current-accounts/what-do-you-need-to-open-a-current-account/).
required_docs: visa or residence permit may be required depending on nationality

schools.summary: Nottingham Girls' High School's official 2026–27 prospectus documents a GCSE and A-level curriculum (https://nottinghamgirls.gdst.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Senior-Prospectus-2026-2027-ONLINE-1.pdf). Nottingham City Council's 2026 school guide directs families to the statutory DfE directory (https://www.nottinghamcity.gov.uk/media/ljajxrn2/gtsin-2026-v2.pdf; https://get-information-schools.service.gov.uk/).

legal_admin.summary: For newcomers whose permission is held as an eVisa, UKVI requires the UKVI account, eVisa details and current passport or travel document to be correct before travel; the eVisa is checked when entering the UK (https://www.gov.uk/evisa/travel-with-evisa).
legal_admin.registration_step: Check or finish setting up the UKVI account, verify eVisa details, and link the current passport or travel document before travel and entry.

tax_finance.summary: Apply online for a National Insurance number and prove identity; GOV.UK says a passport or eligible national identity card can be used and an in-person appointment may be required if those documents are unavailable (https://www.gov.uk/apply-national-insurance-number/how-to-apply).

transport.summary: Nottingham City Transport's Easyrider Everyday adult one-month City Zone pass costs £82 from 1 March 2026 (https://www.nctx.co.uk/season-ticket-price-increases). Non-GB licence holders must use the official checker to determine whether and how their licence can be exchanged (https://www.gov.uk/exchange-nongb-driving-licence). Everyone in England can register with a GP surgery for free, usually online or by paper form, without ID, proof of address or immigration status (https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/gps/how-to-register-with-a-gp-surgery/).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Use the GOV.UK/DVLA non-GB licence checker; exchange eligibility and procedure depend on the issuing licence and the applicant's circumstances.
transport.healthcare_registration: Find a local GP surgery and register online or submit its paper form; ID, proof of address and proof of immigration status are not required.
